material.scopeLabel: Source-scoped Au catalyst deposition, chemical beam epitaxy growth, composition and growth-interruption controls, catalyst-stop preparations, microscopy specimens and five single-nanowire optical contexts. All nine main pages were read in text and images. Exact physical batch identities, unlisted growth times and individual alloy line pressures remain unknown. Figure specimens are not silently joined to unreported recipes. This is not a complete laboratory SOP or a full-paper narrative Reader.
